name: axe
summary: CLI for defining and running single-purpose LLM agents from TOML configs, composable via pipes and Unix tools.
features: Define focused LLM agents in TOML with model, prompt, skills and context
Run agents from terminal, pipes, git hooks or cron
Delegate tasks to sub-agents with depth limiting and parallel execution
Connect to external MCP servers for additional tools

manual_steps: Initialize config directory before first use

steps.command: curl -fsSL -o /tmp/axe.tar.gz https://github.com/jrswab/axe/releases/download/v1.11.0/axe_1.11.0_linux_amd64.tar.gz && mkdir -p ~/.local/bin && tar -xzf /tmp/axe.tar.gz -C /tmp && cp /tmp/axe ~/.local/bin/axe && chmod +x ~/.local/bin/axe && ~/.local/bin/axe version
steps.purpose: download pre-built linux_amd64 binary from GitHub releases and install to ~/.local/bin

setup.command:
cat > /tmp/setup_agents.sh <<'EOS'
set -e
# F1 agent via scaffold
axe agents init my-agent
cat $(axe config path)/agents/my-agent.toml
echo "---F1 scaffold done---"

# Create explicit test agent for F2 with minimal config
mkdir -p $(axe config path)/agents
cat > $(axe config path)/agents/test-pipe.toml <<'TOML'
name = "test-pipe"
description = "Test pipe agent"
model = "openai/gpt-4o-mini"
system_prompt = "You are helpful."
max_turns = 5
TOML

# F3 parent + sub agent
cat > $(axe config path)/agents/sub-child.toml <<'TOML'
name = "sub-child"
description = "child agent"
model = "openai/gpt-4o-mini"
system_prompt = "You are a child."
TOML

cat > $(axe config path)/agents/parent-agent.toml <<'TOML'
name = "parent-agent"
description = "parent that delegates"
model = "openai/gpt-4o-mini"
system_prompt = "You delegate."
sub_agents = ["sub-child"]

[sub_agents_config]
max_depth = 3
parallel = true
timeout = 30
TOML

# F4 MCP agent
cat > $(axe config path)/agents/mcp-test.toml <<'TOML'
name = "mcp-test"
description = "MCP test agent"
model = "openai/gpt-4o-mini"
system_prompt = "You use MCP tools."

[[mcp_servers]]
name = "my-tools"
url = "https://example.com/sse"
transport = "sse"

[[mcp_servers]]
name = "http-tools"
url = "https://example.com/mcp"
transport = "streamable-http"
TOML

echo "setup complete"
ls -l $(axe config path)/agents/
EOS
chmod +x /tmp/setup_agents.sh
/tmp/setup_agents.sh

pitfalls.readme_said: Requires Go 1.25+ and go install / go build
pitfalls.actually_needed: Box has no Go toolchain; installed pre-built binary axe_1.11.0_linux_amd64.tar.gz from GitHub Releases instead

pitfalls.readme_said: axe run <agent> --dry-run shows resolved context without calling LLM
pitfalls.actually_needed: With [[mcp_servers]] or sub_agents configured, axe run --dry-run attempts MCP connections / sub-agent resolution and hangs until timeout (observed 10-15s timeout, exit 124/137); axe agents show still validates TOML

judge.observed: Screenshots show axe listing agents including mcp-test, showing test-pipe details with model openai/gpt-4o-mini, and reporting version 1.11.0.

what_it_does.quote: A CLI tool for managing and running LLM-powered agents.

troubleshooting_uninstall.quote: If this fails with `invalid go version`, your Go toolchain is older than 1.25.

license_and_platforms.quote: are available for Linux, macOS, and Windows on the [GitHub Releases page]

evidence.quote: A CLI tool for managing and running LLM-powered agents.
A lightweight cli for running single-purpose AI agents. Define focused agents in TOML, trigger them from anywhere; pipes, git hooks, cron, or the terminal.
Axe orchestrates LLM-powered agents defined via TOML configuration files.
Pipe data in, get results out. Chain agents together. Trigger them from cron, git hooks, or CI.
Sub-agent delegation — agents can call other agents via LLM tool use, with depth limiting and parallel execution
MCP tool support — connect to external MCP servers for additional tools via SSE or streamable-HTTP transport
